title: Helpful default text
text: helpful default text default values should indicate how to use the setting. no lorem ipsum or demo store content as placeholders.

title: Favicon setting required
text: favicon setting required must include an uploadable favicon setting.

title: Logo handles any aspect ratio
text: logo handles any aspect ratio landscape, portrait, or square logos must all work without breaking the layout.

title: Every setting must have a label
text: every setting must have a label no unlabeled settings anywhere in the theme.

title: Menu defaults
text: menu defaults header link list settings default to main-menu; footer link list settings default to footer.

title: Referenced resources must exist
text: referenced resources must exist any default value pointing to a product or collection must exist in all stores.

title: Standard metaobject definitions only
text: standard metaobject definitions only custom or app-owned metaobject definitions cannot be used as metaobject_type.

title: Include a theme_info section
text: include a theme_info section required in the settings_schema.json.

title: Editor changes reflect instantly
text: editor changes reflect instantly any change in the theme editor must appear immediately in the preview panel.

title: Sentence case
text: sentence case capitalize only the first word and proper nouns. "image gallery" not "image gallery."

title: Descriptive names, not numbers
text: descriptive names, not numbers use "top left, top center" not "position 1, position 2." avoid subject repetition in section headings.

title: American English
text: american english "color" not "colour," "center" not "centre," "canceled" not "cancelled," "catalog" not "catalogue."

title: No ampersands
text: no ampersands always write "and" in full. never use &.

title: Statements not questions
text: statements not questions "use a custom logo" not "use a custom logo?"

title: Active voice, verb-first buttons
text: active voice, verb-first buttons "upload image," "add section," "choose font."

title: Technical spec formats
text: technical spec formats image sizes as 64 x 64px required or 3:2 aspect ratio recommended; word counts as 32 words max.

title: Name relates to function
text: name relates to function use names like "header," "product list," "slideshow," or "image gallery."

title: Suggested names
text: suggested names header, featured products, featured collections, slideshow, image gallery, logo list, newsletter, map, blog posts, testimonials, footer.

title: Preset names relate to content type
text: preset names relate to content type use names like "image and text," "map," "columns," or "blog articles."

title: Use content placeholders
text: use content placeholders if a preset features images, videos, or icons, display placeholder content so merchants can see how it looks before adding their own media.

title: Font Picker
text: font picker use font_picker setting type all font selections must use the font_picker setting type. always set a default font every font picker must have a default value (e.g., default: work_sans_n6). only use available library fonts defaults and preset fonts must exist in shopify's currently available fonts list. load all font variants use the font_modify filter in css to load bold, italic, and bold-italic variants for every font used. custom fonts are not allowed all fonts must come from shopify's library.

title: Color System
text: color system minimum 4 colors required you must define at least 4 colors in your color system. every background needs a matching foreground each background color setting must have a corresponding foreground (text/icon) color setting. use proper color type all color settings must use type: color in the settings schema. good contrast pairing foreground and background combinations must have sufficient contrast for readability.

title: Use proper color type

title: Good contrast pairing
text: good contrast pairing foreground and background combinations must have sufficient contrast for readability.

title: Responsive Images
text: responsive images responsive image strategy all images must adapt and look correct across phones, tablets, and desktops. small icons are exempt. lazy loading required images must load only as they're needed, minimizing the number of images loaded initially per page.

title: Lazy loading required

title: Naming Themes & Presets
text: naming themes & presets no shopify brand names avoid names the same as or similar to shopify products, events, or branded content (e.g., "polaris," "unite," "shopify"). no company or partner names your partner account name is already shown automatically on the listing page. no platform or seo terms avoid generic words like "performance," "mobile," or "sales." no industry or category names don't name your theme after a niche like "fashion," "electronics," or "jewelry." 1–2 words, under 30 characters short, memorable, easy to spell and pronounce. avoid trendy or unusual spellings. unique name required the name must not already exist in the shopify theme store or on other platforms. one preset shares the theme name at least one preset must take the name of the parent theme exactly. multiple presets need a /listings folder each preset goes in its own subfolder inside /listings in your theme zip. single preset — no /listings folder needed you can skip the /listings folder entirely if you only have one preset. each preset must match its demo on install colors, typography, and layout must match the demo store when the merchant installs the preset. demo images won't transfer plan for this; images don't carry over on install.

title: Theme Versions & Release Notes
text: theme versions & release notes version number required on every submission every upload — first submission or update — must include a version number. release notes required clearly highlight the main features and changes in each version so merchants know what they're getting. helps merchants stay informed version numbers let merchants know which version they're on and whether newer updates are available.

title: Demo Stores
text: demo stores one demo store per preset every theme preset must have at least one demo store. create it as a client transfer store from your shopify partner dashboard. match the preset's industry and catalog size the demo must fit the tags assigned to the preset. each preset's install state must also match the demo's expectations. use bogus gateway or test mode all demo stores must have the bogus gateway or shopify payments test mode enabled, with all other checkout options disabled. real, original text content no lorem ipsum, no onboarding text, no profanities anywhere. don't change "powered by shopify" the powered_by_link link cannot be altered and must contain only powered_by_link. no affiliate links not allowed anywhere in the demo store. add rel="nofollow" to shopify links any link in the code pointing to a shopify domain must include the rel="nofollow" attribute. only show built-in theme features no text embedded in images (unless physical products, infographics, or badges), no animated gifs mimicking theme functionality, and no apps (except free review and translation apps). have rights to all assets obtain appropriate rights for all images, brand names, and content per the shopify partner agreement. use shopify burst for royalty-free images.

title: Documentation & Contact Forms
text: documentation & contact forms both are mandatory you must have theme documentation and a public support contact form ready before your theme launches. link both from your theme store listing merchants must be able to find them directly from your theme page. correct grammar and spelling all documentation must be well-written and error-free. match your theme settings language terminology in docs must be consistent with labels used in the theme editor. keep it updated update documentation when shopify changes something or when you release a new theme version. include an faq section answer common merchant questions proactively. warn merchants before editing code remind them to duplicate the theme first and suggest hiring a shopify partner for customizations. required fields name, email address, store url, description of problem (text area), file upload (for screenshots), and auto-responder confirmation. optional but useful theme name (if you have multiple themes) and subject (should auto-fill the email subject line). keep it simple no unnecessary fields like budget, phone number, or project type. mobile-friendly if using a popup/modal form, it must work well on mobile and be directly linkable from the theme store.

title: Supporting Your Theme
text: supporting your theme merchants reach you through your contact form link it from both the shopify theme store listing and your theme documentation. reply within 2 business days all support requests must be acknowledged and responded to within two business days. fix technical issues promptly broken layouts, dead links, and logical errors must be fixed in a timely manner. fix critical bugs immediately serious bugs affecting the shopping experience must be fixed right away, or your theme risks temporary removal from the store. extra services are optional and separate customizations and app integrations can be offered as paid add-ons but cannot be included in the theme price. supporting merchants is a full-time commitment all current theme partners have dedicated support teams. shopify merchants generate thousands of support tickets per month. new partners typically underestimate the time required.
